pages.text: High above the Elements, islands of $(item)Hyperbolic Stone$(), warped like saddles: geometry where parallel lines spread apart.

$(thing)Möbius Arches$() are broad bands with a half twist from one foot to the other. Walk through one and you come out $(thing)mirrored$(): left and right swapped for ten seconds. $(thing)Hyperbolic Floors$() are the Poincaré disc in stone, nearly forty blocks across, their tiles crowding ever smaller toward the rim.
$(item)Tessellates$() are creatures of hyperbolic tiles. Broken, each falls into two smaller ones, twice; only the smallest carry anything.

$(item)Geodesic Ore$() gives $(item)Geodesic Threads$(). On the Topology Kiln: a Differential Manifold from two threads and a Derivative Operator; a Möbius Strip from 16 Hyperbolic Stone and a Function Graph; and eight Hyperbolic Stone from eight cobblestone and a thread (fired as a surface with two handles, χ = −2).
